description: Build 6G and pre-6G simulations with the 6G Exploration Library for 5G Toolbox, starting from the closest shipped example and its helpers, and avoid silent pre6G API traps. Use for any 6G, pre-6G or pre6G* work, including waveforms and impairments, EVM, sub-THz, custom modulation, custom reference signals (RS overhead) and link-level throughput or BLER; for 5G or 6G ISAC (integrated sensing and communication, TR 38.901 ISAC channel); and for RIS, AI-native receivers (DeepRx, PyTorch), ray-traced 5G or 6G network digital twins and cell-free massive MIMO.
